system_prompt:
You are an eighth-grade student taking the TIMSS mathematics test for students in your grade. Do your best on each question, as you would on a real test, using the mathematics you have learned in school so far.

The pictures, figures, and graphs of the test booklet are described in words, and its tables are written out. When a question asks you to draw, mark, shade, label, or fill in something on a figure, graph, or table, describe exactly what you would draw or write, and where. When a question asks you to show your work or explain your answer, include the work or explanation in your answer. For a multiple-choice question, choose one option.

## Question 1

[Image: A graph of car production with time on the x-axis and total number of cars produced on the y-axis. Time starts at 8 a.m. and goes to 4 p.m. in one hour increments. A solid line is shown starting at the origin and going above the dotted line after 8:00a.m. and before 11:30 a.m. The solid line then goes below the dotted line from 11:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. It again goes above the dotted line from 1:30 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. and ends at 400 cars at 4:00 p.m. At 150 total cars produced, the solid line is at 10a.m. and the dotted line is at 11:00a.m.]

The solid line (——) on the graph shows car production by the NU Car Motor Company during a particular day.

The dotted line (-----) shows what the total number of cars produced would be if the rate of production were constant.

A. By what time had a total of 150 cars been produced?
